idiom.note: function-based behaviors, stateful_actor for the cached peer, bare uint64_t on the hot path, one handshake outside the window

caveats: every actor is spawned caf::detached: one OS thread per actor, pinned one per CPU from the harness's set through caf::thread_hook (thread_owner::pool), parked on a condition variable between messages. This explicit placement makes its ping-pong cross a core when the actors use distinct CPUs. The pool favours local hand-offs but may steal; its actual cross-core hop count is not recorded. a detached actor has no spin profile, so this variant reports wait=1 as not applicable rather than measuring a pool configuration under a detached label
